page_title: Paste — Clipboard Manager for Mac, iPhone & iPad

sources.entry: Paste - Smart clipboard history & snippets manager. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/paste-clipboard-history-manager/id967805235?platform=mac)

summary.name: Paste
summary.one_liner: Paste is a clipboard manager for Mac, iPhone, and iPad that saves everything you copy, keeps it searchable, and syncs it across your devices.
use_cases: Find or recover something copied earlier
Give AI tools clipboard history as context
Sync copied items across Mac, iPhone and iPad
Stop sensitive apps or passwords from being saved
summary.what_it_does: Paste saves everything copied with no stated limit, so items from an hour or a year ago remain available. It is organized and searchable, and it suggests what to paste next based on current work, powered by Apple Intelligence and run privately on the Mac. It can connect clipboard history to AI tools such as Claude, Codex and Cursor, which run on the Mac and only receive what the user chooses to share. Clipboard data stays on the device and in private iCloud, and users can set rules so passwords and other sensitive apps are ignored.
notable: Unlimited clipboard history with search and organization
Connects clipboard history to AI tools like Claude, Codex and Cursor
Data stays on device and in private iCloud; ignores passwords and sensitive apps via rules
Next-paste suggestions powered by Apple Intelligence on the Mac
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Listed on the App Store, so the Mac version is distributed through Apple's store
